mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( workspace_id, recipient_id, type, category, severity, template_version, title, body, actor_id, actor_label, source_type, source_id, source_label, context_type, context_id, context_label, action_url, data, dedupe_key, triggered_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{recipientId}, #{type}, #{category}, #{severity}, #{templateVersion}, #{title}, #{body}, #{actorId}, #{actorLabel}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceLabel}, #{contextType}, #{contextId}, #{contextLabel}, #{actionUrl}, #{data}, #{dedupeKey}, #{triggeredAt} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.read_at ), dismissed_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.dismissed_at ), triggered_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, incoming.triggered_at, notification.triggered_at ), resolved_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.resolved_at ), type = incoming.type, category = incoming.category, template_version = incoming.template_version, title = incoming.title, body = incoming.body, actor_id = incoming.actor_id, actor_label = incoming.actor_label, source_type = incoming.source_type, source_id = incoming.source_id, source_label = incoming.source_label, context_type = incoming.context_type, context_id = incoming.context_id, context_label = incoming.context_label, action_url = incoming.action_url, data = incoming.data, severity = incoming.severity

SELECT t.workspace_id, t.id AS task_id, t.description AS task_label, t.due_date, t.assigned_to_id AS recipient_id, u.timezone AS recipient_timezone, d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_label, p.id AS person_id, p.name AS person_label FROM task t JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = t.assigned_to_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = t.assigned_to_id LEFT JOIN deal d ON d.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND d.id = t.deal_id LEFT JOIN person p ON p.id = t.person_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.completed = FALSE AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.id

SELECT DISTINCT d.workspace_id, d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_label, d.expected_close_date, recipients.recipient_id, u.timezone AS recipient_timezone FROM deal d JOIN ( SELECT owned.workspace_id, owned.id AS deal_id, owned.owner_id AS recipient_id FROM deal owned WHERE owned.owner_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT collaborated.workspace_id, collaborated.id AS deal_id, dc.user_id AS recipient_id FROM deal collaborated JOIN deal_collaborator dc ON dc.workspace_id = collaborated.workspace_id AND dc.deal_id = collaborated.id WHERE collaborated.owner_id IS NOT NULL ) recipients ON recipients.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND recipients.deal_id = d.id JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = recipients.recipient_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = recipients.recipient_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.closed_at IS NULL AND d.expected_close_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.id, recipients.recipient_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.workspace_id, d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_label, d.expected_close_date, p.id AS person_id, p.name AS person_label, recipients.recipient_id, u.timezone AS recipient_timezone FROM deal d JOIN deal_person dp ON dp.deal_id = d.id JOIN person p ON p.id = dp.person_id AND p.workspace_id = d.workspace_id JOIN ( SELECT owned.workspace_id, owned.id AS deal_id, owned.owner_id AS recipient_id FROM deal owned WHERE owned.owner_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT collaborated.workspace_id, collaborated.id AS deal_id, dc.user_id AS recipient_id FROM deal collaborated JOIN deal_collaborator dc ON dc.workspace_id = collaborated.workspace_id AND dc.deal_id = collaborated.id WHERE collaborated.owner_id IS NOT NULL ) recipients ON recipients.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND recipients.deal_id = d.id JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = recipients.recipient_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = recipients.recipient_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.id, p.id, recipients.recipient_id
SELECT id FROM workspace ORDER BY id
